title: Panthers Agree One-Year Deal With Tight End Darren Waller
dek: Waller's agency announced the agreement Wednesday night. Terms were not disclosed. The 33-year-old played nine games for Miami last season after coming out of a two-year retirement.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Carolina and Waller agreed a one-year contract announced by his agency, Rosenhaus Sports, on Wednesday night; terms were not disclosed. Waller caught 24 passes for 283 yards and six touchdowns in nine games for Miami last season.

also_reported_by.headline: Reports: Panthers to sign tight end Darren Waller
Panthers to sign TE Darren Waller

body: The Carolina Panthers have agreed a one-year contract with tight end Darren Waller, announced by his agency, Rosenhaus Sports, on Wednesday night. Terms were not disclosed.

Waller is 33 and turns 34 next month. He retired after the 2023 season with the New York Giants, returned to play for Miami in 2025, and caught 24 passes for 283 yards with six touchdowns across nine games there.

He made the Pro Bowl in 2020. The Panthers had gone through the offseason without adding an established receiving tight end, and the team's own site carried the move as reported rather than announced, which is the usual sequence before a contract is formally filed.
The desk notes the deal as agreed and reported, not as executed: until the club announces it, the terms and the roster move both remain subject to a physical and to paperwork.
